extension.summary: Free Flow - Movies, Shows and More by Chains
extension.description: Free Flow is a video addon by Chains that streams Movies, TV Shows, WWE, Documentaries, Kids and more. Sources are read from Chains and resolved via ResolveURL. Posters are fetched from TMDB when missing. Includes full Trakt.tv integration: Trending, Popular, Anticipated, Recommendations, Watchlist, Collection, History, Liked Lists and personal Custom Lists with add / remove / create from the context menu.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host any content. All sources are linked from the open web.
extension.news: v1.7.1 - Fixed empty episode/season lists under Shows (single <link> items now play). v1.7.0 - Built-in ddownload.com resolver (no ResolveURL needed for that host). New Downloads section on the root menu with a "Download to device" context-menu entry on every playable item - shows live progress dialog, saves to a configurable folder (default special://home/downloads/), and lets you replay, delete or re-download items offline. v1.6.1 - Comprehensive Debug logging (default ON). Logs every HTTP/Trakt request, scan cycle, router action and exception to both Kodi log and Settings -> Debug -> View Debug Log. v1.6.0 - My Free Flow + full Trakt integration
